name: 小黑背鷗
illustrationTaxon: Larus fuscus adult in non-breeding plumage, treated here in the broad IOC sense that includes birds breeding in northern Siberia and wintering in east Asia. Medium-dark grey upperparts, greyish head streaks before the spring moult, a small yellow bill with a red spot and predominantly yellow legs; extensive black in the outermost three primaries with one white mirror. A minority of Hong Kong birds are hybrids with Vega Gull and show intermediate structure, plumage or moult. First-year birds (smaller, slimmer, longer-winged, small-billed, broad dark tail band) are not shown.

similarSpecies.distinction: 翼上為中灰而非深石板灰，兩者並排時深淺差別最直接；本種體型較修長、翼較長、嘴較小，成鳥腳多為黃色而本種為粉紅。初級飛羽換羽本種最遲（二月底至三月初），織女銀鷗十二月或一月完成。
翼上為更淡的銀灰，體型更大、胸更深、嘴與翼更長，腳多為粉紅或桃色；成鳥換羽最早（十一月前完成），冬末白色翼尖已磨損，與本種三月初才完成形成明顯對比。

featureNotes: 嘴相對細小，黃色配下嘴紅斑；在幾種大型鷗之中，嘴的大小是判斷本種最快的結構指標（第1圈取自近景圖，整條嘴連紅斑入圈）。
成鳥腳黃色或大部分黃色，是最直接的野外特徵；香港部分個體被視為與織女銀鷗雜交，腳色可由黃至粉紅不等，這點已在卡上註明（第2圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
翼上為中等偏深的石板灰，比織女銀鷗的中灰更深、比蒙古銀鷗的淡銀灰深得多（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
最外三枚初級飛羽（P8–P10）有大片黑色，最外一枚有一個白色「鏡斑」，P9 若有則通常很小（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見；停棲折翼狀態，不代表飛行時圖案）。

rangeMap.note: Country overview only: breeds from Iceland and northwest Europe through Scandinavia east to north Siberia as far as the Taimyr Peninsula, with barabensis in Central Asia; winters from western Europe to equatorial and east Africa, the Middle East to India, and across to south China and east Asia (also a regular non-breeding visitor to North America). Not an occurrence polygon and not split by season.

sources.use: HKBWS Lesser Black-backed Gull (017700) substantive read: 51-61 cm; medium-dark grey upperparts, greyish head streaks before the spring moult and yellow or predominantly yellow legs identify adults in HK; primary moult later than other large gulls and complete in late February or early March; a minority are hybrids with Vega Gull showing intermediate structure, plumage or moult with leg colour from yellow through pinkish-yellow to pink; adults usually have extensive black in P8-P10 with one white mirror on the outermost primary and any mirror on P9 usually small; first-years identified by smaller size, slimmer body, longer wings and smaller bill, no contrastingly paler inner primaries, broad blackish tail band, dark greater coverts; second-winters have dark grey mantle and coverts; most records from the Inner Deep Bay roost, with northward passage flocks off Po Toi 6 January to 12 April and a peak of 291 on 15 March 2007; highest count 865 on 28 January 2000, with winter numbers relatively low since 2015/16; breeds from Iceland and northwest Europe east to the Taimyr Peninsula, winters to Africa, the Middle East, India and south China; IUCN Least Concern, trend increasing.
HKBWS Mongolian Gull (017510) read as the pale contrast species: 56-68 cm, paler grey upperparts, more black in the primaries, pinkish or peachy legs, adult primary moult complete by November.
HKBWS Slaty-backed Gull (017600) read to confirm it is a separate species with equally dark (usually darker) upperparts and different structure, and is rare in Hong Kong.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對深石板灰翼上、黃腳、小黃嘴紅斑與大片黑初級飛羽；不是照片，也不是分佈或族群證據。
分類處理各權威不同：IOC 把北西伯利亞繁殖、東亞越冬的鳥歸入 L. fuscus（跟隨 Collinson et al. 2008）；本卡沿用此廣義處理，卡面名稱用 app 的「小黑背鷗」。
香港部分個體被視為與織女銀鷗的雜交，結構、羽色或換羽居中，腳色由黃至粉紅不等；本卡不宣稱所有個體都能明確歸類。
比較鳥為 AI 生成示意，非等比例；三種灰階深淺只作對照參考。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形，繁殖地與越冬地不分工。
IUCN 無危、趨勢上升；香港是常見冬候鳥與早春過境鳥，最高 865 隻（2000-01-28），但 2015/16 之後冬季數量偏低。
